answer.reason: The request is for a new tile with a large product screenshot in a section of picture tiles. On this instance, the BentoSection component (ID 16) is the card-style section built for screenshots and graphics, and its items are BentoCard content list items (ID 17). Each BentoCard has an Eyebrow, Title, Description and a Graphic image attachment, so a large product screenshot fits its Graphic field. The alternative, GalleryImage (ID 76), is an image grid with only an optional caption and no title or description, so it is a weaker fit for a tile. I did not save anything.
